name: Nakajima Jun
source:
Jun is in his third year of university. He is Arika's boyfriend. For better and for worse, he is a completely normal young man. Though easy-going and optimistic, Jun quickly falters in the face of adversity and is easily rattled. He's in a big group of friends.

[Translated from his [URL=http://www.elle-murakami.com/murakami/01/m27/m27.html]official website profile[/URL].]
